name: SHAVO TECHNOLOGIES PVT LTD
semiconductor_relevance: Medium -- The company provides ultra-high purity fluid control solutions which are important for semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: SEMI S2 Certified Gas Cabinets & VMB's
india_angle: Shavo Technologies has a Pan India presence, supplying systems and components across the country.
summary: Shavo Technologies Pvt Ltd specializes in ultra-high purity fluid control solutions, providing essential components such as pressure regulators, gas cabinets, and analytical solutions for semiconductor manufacturing.
